metadata.title: Broadcom Is About to Face Nvidia's Impossible AI Bar

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Broadcom Inc. (AVGO, Financials) is going to discover how hard it is to follow Nvidia. Following another upbeat growth prediction from Nvidia, the next big test for the artificial intelligence trade on Wall Street is shaping up to be Broadcom's upcoming quarterly earnings.Nvidia just guided for about 70% revenue growth in the next fiscal year, significantly above estimates and another indication that spending on AI infrastructure is quite high.That ups the ante for Broadcom. Unlike Nvidia, Broadcom has been progressively positioning itself around specialized AI accelerators created for large technology customers alongside its networking solutions.Investors will be looking for signs that hyperscalers are still spending on those custom processors, and not just relying on Nvidia's GPUs. The answer is important to the wider market.The S&P 500 is up almost 13% this year and at record levels, with optimism over sustained expenditure on AI infrastructure helping maintain tech values. One of the next big tests for that rally will be Broadcom results and future U.S. jobs statistics, Reuters said.Broadcom doesn't need to mimic the expansion of Nvidia. But investors will want to see proof that the rise in AI investment is wide enough to yield a few big winners in semiconductors. That means Broadcom's next report will cover more than one quarter.
